Keep central windshield open and empty: no other airplane in this image, it will be added as an animated layer by software. Immersive sober naturalistic cinematography, glass reflections, subtle grain, physically plausible light, no weapons firing, no explosion, no logos, no typography. Save generated image as project asset.

One generic unbranded white Airbus A320 type narrowbody passenger jet with two underwing engines, realistic proportions, viewed from behind and slightly above its left rear quarter, nose points toward right of frame, slight bank, whole aircraft visible, muted afternoon sunlight from upper left, realistic grey underside and soft blue reflections. No airlines, no text, no marks, no weapons, no smoke, no landscape, no shadow on ground. Transparent background, aircraft only, wide landscape composition.
